name: App Factory genelleştirme

local_gate.web_gates: no web change in B40; matrix-badges rerun after node scripts/web/sync-feature-matrix.mjs
local_gate.run: 2026-09-15 local, one clean run over the B40 tree (scratchpad b40_gate.log): QUALITY GATE: PASS; API pytest 10773 passed / 5 skipped in 19m40s; staged update qualified; web vitest/tsc/oxlint green; corpus 2291 cases green inside the run

what_this_proves: A sentence the three templates cannot serve becomes a planned, multi-file, stdlib-only Node application whose schema, store, API, optional login, page and tests are generated from what the owner said - with every unread part named back to them; the generated tests really run (under node in the unit tests, on the device through project.test); every generated file is linted and security-scanned before the device sees it; a model may add only the owner's free-text behaviour in two slots, under the owner's flag; and a failed test run is analysed and fixed in a bounded loop that scaffolds a new version each time and stops honestly.

measured_first.before: app/appfactory: AppSpec with three templates, DeterministicAppGenerator rendering them, ClaudeAppGenerator raising unconditionally; the voice tool built a spec from a template word and a name; no requirements parser beyond that (row 422: parsed then dropped); no planners; no db/api/auth/test generation; no failure analysis, fix or loop; no lint; no scan of generated code; ALLOWED_RUN_COMMANDS hard-coded 'node cli.js' while the device admits 'node <entry>'.

found_on_the_way.password_key_is_a_secret: app/security/redaction refuses any 'password:' key in generated text, so the wire field and the JS variable are 'parola'/'entered'.
found_on_the_way.node_gets_no_port: the companion hands a node run no environment port; the generated server binds the manifest's own port.
found_on_the_way.entry_rule: the device admits 'node <entry>' for exactly the manifest's entry; the validator hard-coded 'node cli.js'.
found_on_the_way.plural_and_possessive: 'müşteri adı' of the kind 'müşteri' is the field 'ad'; groups after the colon follow the kinds named before it.

red_first_proof.method: Executed mutations restored from sha256-verified copies (never git checkout); scratchpad b40_mutate.py.
mutations: M1 a part of the sentence the parser cannot read is dropped in silence (422) -> 1 failure(s).
M2 the architecture ignores the login the owner asked for (423/430) -> 1 failure(s).
M3 any node file is admitted as a run command, not only the manifest's entry (428) -> 1 failure(s).
M4 eval() passes the lint (438) -> 1 failure(s).
M5 the model may write any file, not only its slots (425) -> 1 failure(s).
M6 the model is asked with the flag off (425) -> 1 failure(s).
M7 a failing test's name is never read off the report (435) -> 1 failure(s).
M8 the loop keeps trying after the same failure twice (437) -> 1 failure(s).
M9 a fixed version overwrites the project in place instead of a new version (436) -> 1 failure(s).
M10 a security finding in generated code does not block the scaffold (439) -> 1 failure(s).
M11 "Uygulamadaki hatayı düzelt" reaches no tool (435/436) -> 1 failure(s).
red_first_proof.result: 11/11 red; every file restored to its sha256 before the mutation.

runtime_proof.status: PROVEN_AUTOMATED: the generated applications' own tests under the real node on this machine (unit + integration over HTTP), the service and routes through create_app, the fix loop over the scripted device and model. The roadmap's PROVEN_REAL (a free request -> a multi-file application whose tests pass on the owner's device) is READY_FOR_OWNER: it needs the companion's projects family on the device (project.scaffold/test) and, for the model slots and the fix loop, the owner's key and flag (checkpoint 17).

owner_gates.model_budget: READY_FOR_OWNER (checkpoint 17): PAGENTOS_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY + PAGENTOS_APPFACTORY_MODEL_GENERATION_ENABLED=true; without them the composed app is deterministic and app.fix stops at the analysis and says so.
owner_gates.device_lab: a composed application scaffolded, run and tested on the owner's device; its browser oracle replayed by the lab.
